item.title: The Balthasar Evidence Chain
item.description: How Balthasar decides which parts of a conversation may shape the next session, and keeps the evidence behind every decision.

item.title: Memory, then Balthasar
item.description: How human memory works, why retrieval matters, and what that taught us about agent memory

item.title: ROS 1 → ROS 2
item.description: Architecture, migration, installation, and a practical porting workshop

item.title: FAQE presentation theme
item.description: One source file, styled for the web and the terminal

item.title: Running the Nix package manager inside a Docker container
item.description: Try Nix without installing it on the host, mount a project into the official image, and keep the Nix store between runs.

item.title: Set up a Raspberry Pi as a USB-over-IP server
item.description: Share a USB device from a Raspberry Pi and attach it to another Linux machine over a trusted network.

item.title: Using Nix as a package manager for any language
item.description: Use Nix for project tools while leaving Cargo, pip, npm, and other language package managers to manage source dependencies.

item.title: Next-generation system container management
item.description: A practical introduction to LXD system containers and virtual machines, including profiles, storage, snapshots, backups, and the security traps worth knowing.

item.title: How to manage projects, the *NIX way!
item.description: A small project registry, automatic Nix development shells, and a Rofi launcher without a giant IDE workspace.

item.title: Using direnv with Conda
item.description: Activate a project-local Conda environment when entering a directory and cleanly unload it when leaving.

item.title: Hosting a website on the InterPlanetary File System
item.description: Publish a static site to IPFS, pin it, test it through a gateway, and point a human-readable DNSLink name at the current CID.

item.title: Back up OpenPGP keys with Tomb and cryptsetup
item.description: Create an offline OpenPGP primary key, daily-use subkeys, an encrypted Tomb archive, and a separate LUKS2 backup.

item.title: Use a YubiKey for OpenPGP and SSH
item.description: Move OpenPGP signing, encryption, and authentication subkeys to a YubiKey, require touch, and expose the authentication key through gpg-agent for SSH.

item.title: Precision Agriculture
item.description: Sensors, robotics, and artificial intelligence in agriculture
